findings.evidence: template/scripts/task_reconciliation.py `observe_candidate` calls `coordinator_candidate(root)` with no handling. template/scripts/pr_review_gate.py:16-25 `managed_candidate` calls `lifecycle_mode`, which raises when `platform_version` is missing, and `resolve_canonical_provenance`. template/scripts/finish_task.py:438-439 `except Exception` sets `reconcile_required: False`. The candidate's own edit to tests/test_task_reconciliation.py adds `platform_version` to the test config to avoid this.
findings.summary: For any head behind main, `task_reconciliation.observe_candidate` now calls `coordinator_candidate`, which can raise. `finish_task.run_status` turns every exception into `task_freshness: unavailable` with `reconcile_required: False`. A non-candidate task that used to show `behind` with the reconcile hint can now show neither.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/select_checks.py in `main()`: `handoff_evidence = bool(checks) and evidence_path is not None and args.mode == "local-affected" and coordinator_contract(root)`. `coordinator_contract` raises SystemExit on `PlatformConfigError`, which `lifecycle_mode` raises when `platform_version` is absent (_platform_common.py:742-744). The design says a fresh head never depends on the contract.
findings.summary: The `handoff_evidence` guard calls `coordinator_contract(root)` for every evidence-producing `local-affected` run. That includes runs whose head already contains main. A config without `platform_version` now fails with SystemExit before any check, where the old path only needed freshness. The spec says other paths keep the fresh-base gate unchanged.
